# TPC-DI AQ10

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcdi
```

> [TPC-DI](../../tpc-di.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DI queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT 'Regulatory Compliance and Risk Monitoring' AS analysis_name, c.SK_CustomerID, c.Tier, c.Country, COUNT(t.TradeID) AS total_trades, SUM(t.Quantity * t.TradePrice) AS total_trade_value, MAX(t.Quantity * t.TradePrice) AS largest_single_trade, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.Quantity * t.TradePrice > 100000.0 THEN 1 END) AS large_trades, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.DateValue = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 END) AS same_day_trades, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SK_SecurityID) AS securities_traded, SUM(h.CurrentHolding * h.CurrentPrice) AS current_portfolio_value, SUM(h.CurrentHolding * h.CurrentPrice) / c.NetWorth * 100 AS portfolio_to_networth_pct, COUNT(CASE WHEN wash_sales.wash_sale_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) AS potential_wash_sales, AVG(t.Commission) / AVG(t.Quantity * t.TradePrice) * 100 AS avg_commission_rate_pct, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN t.Quantity * t.TradePrice > 100000.0 THEN 1 END) > 10 THEN 'HIGH RISK' WHEN SUM(h.CurrentHolding * h.CurrentPrice) / c.NetWorth > 0.8 THEN 'CONCENTRATION RISK' WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN wash_sales.wash_sale_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 'WASH SALE RISK' WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN d.DateValue = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 END) > 4 THEN 'DAY TRADING RISK' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS risk_profile FROM DimCustomer AS c LEFT JOIN FactTrade AS t ON c.SK_CustomerID = t.SK_CustomerID LEFT JOIN FactHoldings AS h ON c.SK_CustomerID = h.SK_CustomerID LEFT JOIN DimDate AS d ON t.SK_CreateDateID = d.SK_DateID LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.SK_CustomerID, t1.SK_SecurityID, t1.TradeID, CASE WHEN NOT t2.TradeID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS wash_sale_flag FROM FactTrade AS t1 LEFT JOIN DimDate AS t1_date ON t1.SK_CreateDateID = t1_date.SK_DateID LEFT JOIN FactTrade AS t2 ON t1.SK_CustomerID = t2.SK_CustomerID AND t1.SK_SecurityID = t2.SK_SecurityID AND t1.TradeID <> t2.TradeID LEFT JOIN DimDate AS t2_date ON t2.SK_CreateDateID = t2_date.SK_DateID AND ABS((t1_date.DateValue - t2_date.DateValue)) <= 30) AS wash_sales ON t.TradeID = wash_sales.TradeID WHERE c.IsCurrent IS TRUE AND t.Status = 'Completed' AND d.CalendarYearID >= 2015 GROUP BY c.SK_CustomerID, c.Tier, c.Country, c.NetWorth HAVING COUNT(t.TradeID) > 10 ORDER BY CASE risk_profile WHEN 'HIGH RISK' THEN 1 WHEN 'CONCENTRATION RISK' THEN 2 WHEN 'WASH SALE RISK' THEN 3 WHEN 'DAY TRADING RISK' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, total_trade_value DESC LIMIT 50
```
